title: 第20章 意外的消息第21章 暗沼潜蠕
slug: 法师之上第366章五环法师
content_zh:
在三人被冰冻射线而震慑住的时候，高德再次引动法术模型释放法术。
下一刻，他的左手已经是甩出一个翠绿色的液体小球，如一颗充满恶意的彗星划破空气，直奔因为冰冻射线而行动迟缓的为首男人而去。
小球在空中短暂地旋转之后，形成一大片雾状飞溅物，然后准确无误地落在了为首男人身上。
酸液一接触男人，他身上的衣服与皮肤都立刻发出嘶嘶作响的腐蚀之声，冒出滚滚浓烟与刺鼻的硫磺味。
衣服的布料开始融解，皮肤也同样融解，留下一片绿莹莹的腐蚀痕迹。
酸液只持续了三秒左右的时间就消失不见，但是就这三秒已经是让男人痛不欲生，瘫倒在地，翻滚挣扎，不断发出痛苦的哀嚎声。
.......
阴暗的小巷里，酸液迅速的消失，只留下腐蚀的青烟在空气中弥漫。
男人躺在地面上，还在剧烈的抽搐，浑身惨不忍睹，都是烧焦的痕迹，哪里还能看出半分刚刚的凶恶模样。
另外两个人，已经吓得失常。
他们对法师有一定的了解，却又了解的不深，说到底他们也不过就是稍微有些人脉的“小混混”。
所以两人并没有意识到，像高德这般没有背景的法师学徒，在这个年龄，大概率也就是一等学徒，法力有限，所能释放的法术数量最多不会超过五个。
“法师大人，法师大人，饶命......饶命，我们不知道您是法师，冒犯了您，我们再也不敢了.......”
三人中的老二不住求饶，在他眼里，眼前这个脸上还带着稚气的少年，简直是比城里黑帮的头号打手还要可怕。
“您是尊贵的法师，不要与我们这群人渣一般见识，不要再对我们出手了。”他眼看着高德的指尖又有灵光泛现，声音发抖地说道。
老大的惨状就在眼前，实在让他没有半点反抗的勇气。
他害怕自己落得和老大一样的结局。
高德默不作声地放下了右手，强压住心中的怒气，冷冷开口道：“你们是谁？为何袭击我！”
与先前同样的问题，只是这一回他们却是老老实实回答了。
“我们是诺丁汉煤矿的矿工.....”

他见到高德怒气似乎消了些许，就如溺水的人呼吸到了氧气，忙不迭地全盘吐出，“自从诺丁汉矿脉枯竭，我们三人就失去了工作，只能在城里打打杂工，有一天没一天地干着。”
“我们知道这样下去不是事，前几天喝酒的时候听到一个消息，说是不莱梅城有一个新矿场开工，急需矿工，我们就准备去那边接着操持老本行，只是.......”
“只是你们平常有钱就都花在了酒馆之中，所以现在要用钱的时候甚至连路费都拿不出来的是吧？”高德了然，冷冷说道。
这个时代下的矿工，通常都不会有所谓的储蓄意识，个个都是“月光族”。
一领到工资，那都是先爽了再说，把钱都花在了饮酒或者寻欢之上。
所以每月月初结算工钱的时候，便是城里酒馆最热闹、生意最好的时候。
老二男有些窘迫，但还是不断求饶，“是我们不思上进，是我们动了歪心思，法师大人您不要与我们这些人渣计较........”
“为什么挑中我做目标，我看着像是有钱人的样子吗？”高德并没有就此放过三人的意思，寻根问底。
老二紧张不已，小心翼翼看了高德一眼，解释道：“是老大，前段时间菲尔魔药店招聘临时采药人，我们三人都去了，跟着店员们上山采荆棘草，干了几天的采药人……”
此人所言，高德竟然也还有印象。
他与艾米第一次前往菲尔魔药店的时候，确实见到药店门口的水牌上写着招收临时采药人，完全对得上。
“采药间隙，老大在和他们店员闲聊时，有个店员分享了个趣事：
他们药店合作的四个药园中，就你们药园的魔药师最爱折腾，一边向他们出货低级药剂，一边又不断向他们采购高级药材，把赚来的钱大部分又都还给他们了........”
“然后领头的药师就出声呵斥他不许对塞达药师不敬。
他还说塞达药师在闭关研制高级魔药，足不出户，连出货与采购都是让手下学徒做的，足以见其之专注，一旦炼制出高级魔药，那可就不得了.......”
content_en:
When the three of them were shocked by the freezing ray, Gothe once again activated the spell model to release the spell.
The next moment, his left hand was already throwing out a small ball of emerald green liquid, which cut through the air like a malicious comet and headed straight for the leading man who was slow in action due to the freezing ray.
After the ball briefly rotated in the air, it formed a large mist-like splash, and then landed accurately on the leading man.
As soon as the acid came into contact with the man, his clothes and skin immediately hissed and corroded, and billowing smoke and the pungent smell of sulfur emitted.
The fabric of the clothes began to melt, and so did the skin, leaving a green trace of corrosion.
The acid only lasted for about three seconds before disappearing, but these three seconds were enough to make the man miserable. He collapsed to the ground, rolled and struggled, and kept making painful wails.
.......
In the dark alley, the acid quickly disappeared, leaving only corrosive smoke filling the air.
The man was lying on the ground, still twitching violently. His whole body was in terrible shape, with burnt marks, and he could still see any trace of his previous ferocious appearance.
The other two people were so frightened that they went crazy.
They have a certain understanding of mages, but they don't understand them deeply. In the final analysis, they are just "little gangsters" with a few connections.
Therefore, the two of them did not realize that a mage apprentice with no background like Gothe would most likely be a first-class apprentice at this age. He had limited magic power and could release no more than five spells at most.
"Master Mage, Master Mage, spare your life... Spare your life, we don't know you are a mage, we have offended you, we will never dare to do it again..."
The second among the three couldn't help but beg for mercy. In his eyes, the boy with a childish face in front of him was simply more terrifying than the top thug of the city's gang.
"You are a noble mage, don't be like us scum, and don't take action against us again." He said with a trembling voice as he saw a spiritual light appearing on Gothe's fingertips again.
The boss's tragic situation was right in front of him, and he really didn't have the slightest courage to resist.
He was afraid that he would end up like his boss.
Gothe put down his right hand silently, suppressed the anger in his heart, and said coldly: "Who are you? Why did you attack me!"
The same question as before, but this time they answered it honestly.
"We are miners at Nottingham Colliery..."
He saw that Gothe's anger seemed to have subsided a little, just like a drowning man breathing oxygen, and he hurriedly spit it out, "Since the Nottingham mines dried up, the three of us have lost our jobs and can only work as odd jobs in the city, day after day."
"We know it won't be a problem if this continues. When we were drinking a few days ago, we heard the news that a new mine has started construction in Bremen and there is an urgent need for miners. We are going to go there and continue to operate our business, but..."
"It's just that you usually spend all your money in the tavern, so when you need money now, you can't even come up with travel expenses, right?" Gao De understood and said coldly.
Miners in this era usually don't have the so-called savings consciousness, and all of them are "moonlight tribe".
As soon as I received my salary, I would feel happy first and then spend all the money on drinking or having fun.
Therefore, when wages are settled at the beginning of each month, it is the busiest time for the pubs in the city and the best business.
The second male was a little embarrassed, but he kept begging for mercy, "It's because we don't want to make progress, it's because we have wrong ideas. Master Master, please don't argue with us scum..."
"Why did you choose me as the target? Do I look like a rich man?" Gothe didn't intend to let the three of them go and asked for the root cause.
The second child is very nervous and careful.Yi glanced at Gothe and explained: "It's the boss. Some time ago, Phil's Potion Store was recruiting temporary herb pickers. The three of us went there and followed the clerks up the mountain to pick thorn grass. We worked as herb pickers for a few days..."
Gaode actually still had an impression of what this person said.
When he and Amy went to Phil's Potion Store for the first time, they did see the water sign at the door of the store saying that they were recruiting temporary herb pickers, which was completely correct.
“While collecting herbs, the boss was chatting with their clerk, and one of the clerks shared an interesting story:
Among the four medicine gardens that their pharmacy cooperates with, the magicians in your medicine garden are the most tossing. While shipping low-level potions to them, they continue to purchase high-level medicinal materials from them, and return most of the money they earn to them..."
“Then the leading pharmacist yelled at him not to be disrespectful to Seda Medicine Master.
He also said that Medicine Master Seda is developing high-grade potions in seclusion without leaving home. Even the shipping and purchasing are done by his apprentices, which shows his concentration. Once he refines high-grade potions, it will be terrible..."
